subject: mathematics
question_text: Find λ if the volume of the parallelepiped having the edges i + j, 3i − j and 3j + λk is 16 cubic units.

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IA (2026-27 edition), book p.67, chapter 7 PRODUCT OF VECTORS, Short Answer question 4(i). Only the question was taken. The solution, the step order and the mark split are this answer book's own work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. THE MARK SPLIT IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S: the Mathematics-IA volume prints no per-step mark allocation on any answer. The split gives half the marks to the determinant, because that is where the work is, and a full mark to the modulus step, because the modulus is what produces both values of λ. The book prints this item as "4. i)" but no part ii) follows it — the next printed item is question 5 — so the card is filed under part (i) as printed. Both evaluations of the box product agree at −4λ: the first-row expansion gives 1(−λ) − 1(3λ) + 0 = −4λ, and the third-column expansion gives λ(1(−1) − 1(3)) = −4λ; computing b × c = (−λ, −3λ, 9) and dotting with a gives −4λ a third time. The answer is λ = ±4, not λ = −4 alone: the volume is |[a b c]| = 4|λ|, so λ = 4 builds a box of the same size with the edges taken in the opposite order. A solution that prints only one value has dropped the modulus. Paper position: Maths-1A Section B prints eight short answers of which the student writes any six, each worth 4 marks, under the 2026-27 pattern; Product of Vectors supplies one of them. This is a coaching publication, not a TSBIE document, so the split stays unverified until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find λ here — name the formula, the determinant, and what the modulus does to your answer.

steps.label: State the formula
steps.margin_note: First mark. Write the modulus bars now. They are what produces the second value of λ at the end.
steps.memory_tip: Parallelepiped takes the whole box product; the one sixth belongs to the tetrahedron.
lines: Let a = i + j, b = 3i − j, c = 3j + λk
Volume of the parallelepiped on a, b, c is
A volume is the MODULUS of a box product.

recall.must_convey: That the volume of a parallelepiped on three edges is the modulus of their scalar triple product.
accept: the volume is the modulus of the box product of the three edges
write V equals mod of a b c
state the parallelepiped volume formula, no one sixth here
volume ante box product yokka modulus
the triple product with modulus bars gives the volume

steps.why: The scalar triple product gives the signed volume of the box on the three edges, and a volume is never negative, so the modulus bars are part of the formula.
common_mistakes: Writing V = [a b c] with no modulus bars.
Using ⅙[a b c], which is the tetrahedron formula.

steps.label: Evaluate the determinant
steps.margin_note: Half the marks. The three edges are the rows. Both a and b have a zero k component — write the zeros in.
steps.memory_tip: Rows are the three edges, in the order given. A missing zero shifts the whole row.

recall.must_convey: That the box product is the 3×3 determinant of the three edges and evaluates to −4λ.
accept: put the three edges as rows and expand to get minus four lambda
the determinant comes to minus four lambda
expand along the third column and get the same minus four lambda
moodu edges ni rows ga petti expand cheste minus four lambda vasthundi
the box product is minus four lambda

steps.why: Expanding a second way is the cheapest check there is: the same determinant reached from a different row or column must give the same number.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the zero k components of a and b.
Getting the plus, minus, plus sign pattern wrong.

steps.label: Solve for λ
steps.margin_note: Last mark. Both values are correct. Give both, or half the answer is missing.
steps.memory_tip: A modulus equation |x| = k always has two answers, +k and −k.

recall.must_convey: That 4|λ| = 16 gives |λ| = 4, so λ is 4 or −4.
accept: four mod lambda equals sixteen so lambda is plus or minus four
the modulus gives two answers, four and minus four
modulus valla rendu answers vasthayi, four and minus four
both plus four and minus four give a volume of sixteen
reject: the determinant is minus four lambda

steps.why: The modulus gives two cases. Both boxes have the same size; the sign of the triple product only records the order in which the edges were taken.
common_mistakes: Dropping the modulus and losing one of the two answers.
